a: $12M to $25M per award over 5 years; about 4 to 8 awards ($100M total, about $20M per year)
dt: Required letter of intent by 5 PM ET Nov 9, 2026 (LOI responses by Nov 23); applications by 11:59 PM ET Jan 12, 2027; webinar Nov 4, 2026
e: Institutional grants for four-year PhD training pilots that pair AI ("super intelligence") with another science discipline, with research stints at a DOE national laboratory or SC user facility and in industry, tied to the Genesis Mission science challenges. Lead must be a US doctoral-granting institution, one LOI or application per lead institution; Fellows must be US citizens or permanent residents, with no such limit on PIs or mentors.
n: DOE Genesis Mission Graduate Fellowship Pilot (DE-FOA-0003673)
